title: Bad Start to a Busy Week
summary: This week promises to be an exciting one, with potentially market-moving news on various fronts. We have tomorrow’s trilateral meeting featuring the leaders of the US, China, and Russia, a major IPO, and several high-profile earnings reports to contend with. The most notable earnings release will arrive tomorrow afternoon, when now-beleaguered Nvidia (NVDA) reports after the close. After a positive week where investors shrugged off “minor” inconveniences like a substantial rise in interest rates and Jensen Huang’s resignation under fire, traders are displaying much more concern today.
